div.div:
Stateless means every request starts from nothing.
The two calls above hit the same model with the same API key, seconds apart — and the second one has no idea the first one existed. Build a chatbot on this and the user has to restate the context in every single message.

switch.text: Stateless means every request starts from nothing....
